connector.name: Publicdata Kr
connector.registryDescription: Korean public data API gateway for discovering and calling data.go.kr APIs from MCP clients.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the NuGet package FieldCure.Mcp.PublicData.Kr. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the fieldcure account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.
